name: I Am Chameleon
summary:
**I Am Chameleon** is a fast, funny VR hide-and-seek game where blending in is your best weapon.

Run, climb, and scramble through colorful maps using hand-based VR movement while trying to disappear into the world around you. Paint yourself to match walls, props, and textures, then freeze in plain sight while other players try to spot you.

Every round is a mix of chaos, sneaky hiding, and hilarious near misses. One second you are racing across the map, and the next you are pretending to be part of a wall
